title.en: Хочу: a thing or an action?

summary.en: Look after the desire word to see which construction follows.

body.en:
From season 1, episode 6.

In episode 6 a caller uses **я хочу забронировать столик**. **хочу** identifies the speaker's desire, and **забронировать** names the desired action in its infinitive form.

A form of **хотеть** can instead be followed by a noun. That noun names the desired thing, rather than an action the speaker wants to perform. Both patterns occur in the episode, so do not assume every word after **хочу** will be a verb.

Useful person forms include **хочу**, **хочешь** and **хотите**. With an infinitive, only the form of **хотеть** changes for the person. The second verb stays in the infinitive.

When listening to a request, separate the desire from its object. Is the speaker asking for a thing, or saying what they want to do? Recognising that early makes the rest of the phrase easier to follow.
